authorship: Codex ordinary-control exclusive seat; no DeepSeek/Claude
scope: paper state, interface and update accounting only; no physical implementation or performance execution

OC1-v1.selection: direct release / release ancestor / structural depth / RR, every fourth grant source-RR
OC1-v1.optional_policy_updates: TTL decrement up to K per coordinator round, pin_enable on timeout/real-demand/fill/registration; g and RR on grant
OC1-v1.structural_depth_derivation: derive from N-task DAG; at N=4 depths fit 2 bits/task if cached, but caching is not required or charged as mandatory
OC1-v1.comparison_use: preserved original ordinary design; do not use its optional TTL/depth overhead as proof of CO1 exclusive lower cost

OC1-min.construction_order: v1 saved first; root then requested necessary-cost check; min built after CO1 card read from specified ordinary modules
OC1-min.selection: release-path boolean, registration age, source RR; unique task-slot defer token must be served at next eligible choice
OC1-min.mandatory_policy_state_bits: N*ceil(log2(N)) + 1 source-RR bit + (1 valid+ceil(log2(N))) defer bits; at N=4: 8+1+3=12 bits
OC1-min.age_scope: one trusted finite N<=4 registration episode; 2-bit ordinal per task, no slot reuse with old callbacks outstanding; registration generation/quiesce is a paid common term
OC1-min.why_TTL_is_unnecessary: committed fill always has original-cache PLRU escape; solitary eligible task immediately falls back; two-head defer bounds bypass to one grant

bounds_and_widths.epoch_note: E must prevent context/root/mapping reuse; native IOTLB tags have no E. Width and wrap/quiesce contract are unresolved paid common terms, not zero.

formal_key_and_phase_uses_materialized_b.legal_reuse: range or interval representation, native tag reuse, bit popcount instead of duplicate counter are allowed to both

task_descriptor_and_context_inputs.range_formula: N*3*A; at N4 A64 = 768 bits if materialized
task_descriptor_and_context_inputs.context_formula: N*(PSCID+GSCID+2+E); at N4 = 152+4*E bits if materialized
task_descriptor_and_context_inputs.storage_reuse: ordinary and CO1 may refer directly to existing frontend/software immutable descriptors; no forced duplicate if lifecycle/read-port contract is paid

task_dag_ready_lifecycle_and_buffer_inte.task_native_source_bits: N*ceil(log2(2)); maximum 4 in min paired scope; source-ID or bus matching extras are common
task_dag_ready_lifecycle_and_buffer_inte.DAG_transitive_or_release_query: at N4 bounded reachability over <=16 directed bit positions; reuse or recompute allowed

buffer_ownership_and_actual_release.reuse: existing producer/consumer software ownership state allowed with all reads, synchronization and handoff charged

last_translation_handoff_proof.required: per task/key/read-or-write final native physical-result handoff and no further lookup/replay proof
last_translation_handoff_proof.current_native_anchor: TC AWAIT_RESP latches translation, COMPLETE accepts actual downstream AR/AW; last-use/task/key association and callback are not present for free
last_translation_handoff_proof.interface_payload_formula: task_slot log2(N), side1, exact key or indexed key log2(K) with validated binding, generation/epoch/source association, proven-last flag/status; choose direct or indexed representation fairly
last_translation_handoff_proof.why_not_mandatory_duplicate_counters: existing immutable range/progress/last metadata may be reused if actual call chain proves exact final use; otherwise counters/proof are paid or early-clear disabled
last_translation_handoff_proof.event_count_success_maximum: <=2*N*K successful side-bit retirement events per finite episode; at N4 K16 <=128; repeated native segments may have additional paid proof/feedback

native_data_completion_and_error.normal_success_anchor: actual AXI B -> write datapath response -> w_last_burst -> idma_rsp_valid -> frontend WAIT completion
native_data_completion_and_error.native_error_field_under_this_configurat: forced zero; not a full success/error proof
full_cost_components: every task full R/W/B response and job identity
invalidations/fences/acks and global ordering if reclaim required

ports_and_update_costs.data: N task descriptors, context/epoch, DAG, source/function association, B owner/release, genuine ready
ports_and_update_costs.logical_work: validate <=4-node DAG and resource dependencies; enumerate <=16 distinct registered keys; range-derived read/write membership <=2*N*K tests (128 maximum)
ports_and_update_costs.fallback: reject incomplete/overflow/stale registration, retain true owner obligations

ports_and_update_costs.interface: native cache current-tag/residency and fill/eviction/invalidation feedback
ports_and_update_costs.existing_source: IOTLB lookup_i/lu_hit_o/lu_content_o plus research tag snapshot; neither is a free general online epoch/permission/dependency interface
ports_and_update_costs.minimum_logical_match_work: up to K*C exact native-context/way matches, maximum 256, or <=K sequential native lookup requests with paid arbitration and way association
ports_and_update_costs.native_update_inputs: actual key/context/current tag/fill way/invalid status; mapping epoch and task association require paid routing
ports_and_update_costs.permission_lookup_note: OC1 pin is replacement advice, so tag observation never authorizes access; a legal-hit credit fast path would require its own paid native permission/context lookup
ports_and_update_costs.update_timing_requirement: mask stable before native update; all-zero falls to native all-ways PLRU. If not achievable without added result slot, disable dynamic pin rather than invent free slot.

ports_and_update_costs.logical_state_write: one selected users bit cleared per exact callback, then OR/reduction to derive protected mask
task lifecycle/ready edges, actual B/owner state, B buffer release on trusted final event; clear defer only when ineligible/stale/retired

ports_and_update_costs.existing_restricted_gate: HOLD source0/1 only strict64B; old ResearchPort source1 incompatible with banked nonblock role configuration
ports_and_update_costs.matched_scope: two native source heads, four task records; software pre-kick or newly implemented generic admission/association routes
ports_and_update_costs.decision_work_min: <=2 eligible tests and release-path/age/RR comparison; defer first if still eligible; update RR1 and defer3 bits at grant

ports_and_update_costs.logical_work: invalidate/disable affected advice, keep task/data obligations, rescan/re-register at valid epoch; native invalidation dominates fill

CO1_to_OC1min_shared_state_mapping: same formal key and two phase-user bitmaps
same release-path boolean and registration-age information
same two-source RR and unique task-slot defer state
paired_minimum_cost_statement.exact_same_policy_outputs_condition: root accepts same two-head defer-token establishment, invalid-token handling, no-other-head fallback and native fill mask definition
paired_minimum_cost_statement.interpretation: A concrete ordinary composition expresses the bounded actions without v1 optional overhead. This rejects an exclusive action/necessary-state claim under the matched contract; it is not a published-prior-art or all-architecture impossibility result.
